extracted.intended_audience: general readers, historians, and enthusiasts of 19th-century naval exploration and Australian natural/history travelogues
extracted.subtask_description: A 19th-century shipboard journal and travelogue describing coastal surveys, natural history observations, and encounters with Indigenous peoples during the voyage of H.M.S. Beagle around Australia and nearby islands. The text is narrative, descriptive, and observational rather than prescriptive or instructional.
